sections.title: Parameters
sections.description: Donor lifetime, Förster radius, energy-migration time and rotational correlation time, and the donor-acceptor distance they imply. Edit the migration time to compute the distance, or the distance to back-map the migration time.

sections.label: k_homo
sections.description: Homo-FRET (energy-migration) rate constant (derived from t_RM / rho). A computed output, not an input.

sections.label: R_DA
sections.description: Donor-acceptor distance implied by the homo-FRET rate. Editable input that back-maps to the anisotropy relaxation time.

sections.label: σ
sections.description: Width of the distance distribution shown in the plot below.

sections.label: χ distribution
sections.description: Use a 3D non-central chi distance distribution (non-negative, vanishes at contact) instead of a Gaussian.

sections.title: Distributions
sections.description: The distance distribution and the anisotropy-decay-time distribution it induces, drawn in their own windows.

sections.title: Distance distribution
sections.description: Distance distribution around R_DA: Gaussian vs the non-negative chi distribution (active one solid).

sections.title: Anisotropy decay time
sections.description: Characteristic anisotropy-decay time distribution: rotational depolarisation (rho) in parallel with energy-transfer depolarisation (2·k_FRET).
